summary: The candidate fixes the first indexed-assignment failure for the primary FP16-activation/BF16-cache case, but is only a partial fix. Its tests stop at the extracted store helper. On gfx950, the original issue's BF16-activation/FP32-cache override proceeds past that helper and then fails in the immediately following production causal_conv1d_fn Triton compilation because mixed state types remain unsupported.

tests.command: /tmp/amdpilot-repo-j-889cab57f561/venv/bin/python direct torch indexed-assignment reproducer on base (CPU and cuda:0)
tests.what_was_measured: The original index_put dtype error reproduced for BF16/FP16, FP16/BF16, and FP32/BF16 destination/source pairs on CPU and the assigned gfx950 GPU; raw/index_put_repro.txt.
At exact candidate commit 4b0d2276, all 17 tests and 27 subtests passed, including the candidate's helper-only dtype cases; raw/pytest_candidate.txt.
Four cross-dtype combinations with non-contiguous sources exactly matched explicit source.to(cache_dtype) references and preserved unselected slots; raw/adversarial_gpu.txt.

tests.command: /tmp/amdpilot-repo-j-889cab57f561/venv/bin/python independent gfx950 causal_conv1d_fn mixed-dtype boundary cases
tests.what_was_measured: FP16 activation/BF16 cache succeeded, while BF16 activation/FP32 cache and BF16 activation/FP16 cache produced Triton CompilationError mismatched-state-type failures; the script records expected per-case outcomes and exits zero; raw/production_conv_mixed_dtype.txt.

gpu_evidence: One AMD Instinct MI355X gfx950 executed the base reproducer, candidate helper adversarial checks, and production causal-convolution boundary checks.
remaining_counterexamples: With BF16 activations and SGLANG_MAMBA_CONV_DTYPE=float32, the candidate's casted snapshot write succeeds but the immediately following ROCm Triton causal_conv1d_fn fails to compile due to FP32/BF16 new_conv_state branch type mismatch.
On the tested ROCm path, BF16 activations with an FP16 conv cache fail at the same causal-convolution boundary after the candidate helper succeeds.
remaining_limitations: QuantTrio/Qwen3.6-27B-AWQ weights were unavailable, so full serving and semantic accuracy were not tested.
The available device was AMD Instinct MI355X gfx950 with ROCm 7.2, not the reporter's RTX 5090 SM120 with CUDA 13.3.
The deterministic tiny Llama serving fixture cannot qualify the qwen3_5 hybrid-GDN architecture and was therefore not substituted as proof.
No native source changed in the candidate, so no native rebuild was applicable.
